summary: Operator-facing rename only: the v2 view becomes 'ATR Bot' and the ORB view 'ORB Bot', plus the ORB account label 'ORB Paper Observer' -> 'Paper Simulation'. +35/-8 across runtime_registry.py, control_plane.py and one new test. Ancestor property checked with the gate's own test first. THE CONTROL IS NOT SELF-COMPARING - the trap I found on ORBLBL, where both existing assertions compared ORB_PAPER_ACCOUNT_NAME to itself so renaming the VALUE turned nothing red. Here the test asserts LITERAL strings ('ATR Bot', 'ORB Bot') and mutation confirms it: reverting display_name to 'Schwab 1 Min Bot v2 (isolated)' turns test_atr_and_orb_use_operator_names_without_changing_their_routes RED. ⭐ AND IT PINS THE THING A RENAME MOST ENDANGERS - the ROUTES: account_name stays live:schwab_1m_v2 for the ATR bot and paper:orb for ORB, with execution_mode=paper and provider=none. A label change that silently moved a route is the real hazard and it is controlled. BROKER-ACCOUNT SAFETY VERIFIED ON THE DEPLOYED BOX WITH THE REAL SERVICE ENV, not a bare Settings(): configured_broker_account_registrations returns ['paper:polygon_30s','live:schwab_1m_v2','live:orb'] and the Webull adapter still resolves ['live:orb'], so the v2 dual-broker fan-out route is intact after the rename. ⛔ MY OWN NEAR-MISS, RECORDED: a scratch check with a bare Settings(orb_enabled=True) returned only ['paper:macd_30s'] and I almost reported the fan-out account MISSING - the fixture did not match production. Re-running against /etc/project-mai-tai/project-mai-tai.env is what refuted it. ⭐ SEPARATE FINDING, NOT BLOCKING: that same check showed ORB_ENABLED=false NO LONGER removes live:orb (measured both ways on the box), so the long-standing 'the ORB flag must stay true or the fan-out breaks' dependency is GONE since #939 moved ORB to paper:orb; I have marked my memory of it superseded. 19 focused tests pass; the ORB paper boundary suite still passes alongside.
